response.courseDescription: 310 Introduction to Transport Processes Fundamentals of the phenomena governing the transport of momentum, energy, and mass.
response.coursePrerequisites: CHE 201 with a C or better; MATH 315 with a C or better or concurrent enrollment; BIO ENG 205 or both CHE 101 and CHE 211 with a C or better or concurrent enrollment; admitted to the major in CHE or BIO ENG.
